Edit this production VFX sprite sheet. Preserve exactly these six effects in the same 3 columns x 2 rows arrangement, order, colors and painterly style. Shrink EACH effect to occupy at most 62% width and height of its own equal square cell. Each effect and all its glow MUST fade entirely to alpha zero before reaching the central 80% boundary of its cell. All gutters, outer canvas edges and empty areas must be truly fully transparent. Remove any tinted rectangular backdrop or full-cell haze. Keep only the isolated effect and its softly fading local glow. No overlapping cells, no cutoff rays or particles, no text or frames. This is an atlas for alpha compositing on both pale and dark backgrounds.
